scope: new application analysis of existing frozen E28b artifacts; NOT a new independent confirmation, new training algorithm, real network benchmark or industrial deployment

cell.origin: original development-selected E28b primary cell; no replacement using new replay outcomes

model: observed_p/selected_state.pt, same 8775-parameter dual_feature_spectral model, no training or parameter edits
target_roles: original test_sealed node IDs only; targets' labels and reference logits are NOT inputs to routing

workloads.name: small_batch
workloads.selection: numpy default_rng(28615 + graph_seed), choose node positions without replacement, sorted; no prediction/label-dependent selection

ordering: cyclic rotation by graph seed index + workload index + repetition; no outcome-dependent ordering

timing.boundary: fresh service and empty messages each run; include service index/snapshot setup, local nominal inference if required, metadata receipt, certificate, dependency planning, serialization/decoding and exact fallback; model/data disk load and offline central-reference audit excluded
timing.interpretation: single-process CPU protocol replay only; no real transport latency or distributed speedup claim

metadata.certificates: uint32 upper counts for every local row of target-owning clients; exact receipt values still interpreted as upper bounds
metadata.source: simulated authoritative partition service; account request/response application payload; real ledger authenticity/acquisition cost remains an external premise

fallback.interface: authorized owner-side exact aggregation, without disclosing remote raw features/endpoint lists to the certification policy
fallback.normalization: complete degree including self loop at each owner; all remote-remote dependencies included
fallback.sharing: deduplicate each batch by source node, receiving owner and propagation order; common engine/batching/codec for every strategy
fallback.cache: no complete-graph propagated feature or logit precomputation; gated methods may reuse their actually computed owner-local encoder outputs and invariant logits; all such computation timed
fallback.service_planning: owner-private adjacency is an existing partitioned input store; every cross-owner dependency requires a serialized request/response; planning stays behind service API
fallback.wire: snapshot-bound binary application payload, IDs, layer and owner fields, float64 aggregate vectors; excludes TCP/TLS/access-control overhead
fallback.unavailable: no certificate => exact fallback, never silently treat unavailable as certified

numerics.classes: exact argmax equality, same first-index tie rule; no tolerance for class flips
numerics.limit: guard is not an outward-rounding proof; zero replay mismatches is an implementation check, not machine-level soundness

analysis.unit: whole-graph seed; clients/nodes/repetitions are not independent replicates
analysis.primary: total serialized application payload including metadata; cone compared with exposure_only and nonnegative_diameter, and full_reference
analysis.secondary: CPU replay time, requests, remote vectors, propagated rows, numerical/class agreement and small-batch results
analysis.summaries: mean of seed-level ratios and per-seed median CPU times; paired seed bootstrap 10000 draws with RNG 28616, descriptive only
analysis.pilot_gate: zero class mismatches and all integrity checks; mean primary payload reduction versus exposure_only at least 5%, positive in at least 6/8 seeds; positive mean incremental payload reduction versus nonnegative_diameter and full_reference. Engineering feasibility threshold only, not a journal acceptance criterion.
analysis.tradeoff: communication savings do not imply CPU speedup; report both, including negative results
analysis.negative: stop application expansion; retain certification-paper positioning, no replacement cell/seed/threshold

integrity.freeze: exclusive freeze_manifest.json pins protocol, inputs and implementation BEFORE replay outcomes
integrity.writes: new files only; exclusive creation; failed runs retained; no silent overwrite/resume or altered old artifacts
integrity.checks: input artifact hashes before/after; model fingerprint before/after; exact fallback versus independent central fullgraph reference; nominal and historical certificate masks cross-check
